finalText:
All 13 reservations on AA918 have been moved to new flights and AA918 now has no bookings left. Nobody was charged a change fee or fare difference: no money moved on any rebooking and the ledgers I checked have no entries. Ten vouchers were issued, and each passenger got one message with their new flights and what they're owed.

There were no operational bulletins, so the standard rules applied. I checked tier history for the six platinum and gold passengers and none had changed. The only open replacement flights were the SFO–ORD and ORD–BOS flights listed below. Searches for nonstop SFO–BOS flights and for connections through DEN, JFK and LAX found no flights.

Original scheduled arrival was 13:40 on 3 Aug at ORD, or 18:55 on 3 Aug at BOS for the two passengers connecting to Boston. Passengers are listed in priority order:

| # | Passenger (res) | Tier | New itinerary (cabin) | Arrival / delay | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Chloe Park (R6103) | Platinum | UA88 06:15–12:25, 3 Aug (Business) | Early | None |
| 2 | Iris Vance (R6109) | Platinum | UA88 06:15–12:25, 3 Aug (**Premium Economy, upgraded from Economy**) | Early | None |
| 3 | Jun Takeda (R6110) + Kofi Mensah (R6111), travelling together, ranked at Kofi's gold tier | Gold | AA204 09:05–15:15, 3 Aug (Economy, together) | +1h35 | None |
| 4 | Ben Okafor (R6102) | Gold | DL512 12:30–18:40, 3 Aug (Economy) | +5h | $150 compensation |
| 5 | Farid Haddad (R6106) | Gold | UA88 06:15–12:25, 3 Aug (Basic Economy) | Early | None |
| 6 | Lea Sorensen (R6112) | Gold | AA204 09:05–15:15, 3 Aug (**Business, upgraded from Premium Economy**) | +1h35 | None |
| 7 | Dev Mehta (R6104) | Silver | AA210 17:40–23:50, 3 Aug, then AA1410 ORD 09:00–BOS 12:25, 4 Aug (Economy) | +17h30, next day | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 8 | Mo Farah (R6113) | Silver | Same as Dev | +17h30, next day | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 9 | Hugo Brandt (R6108) | Silver | AA210 17:40–23:50, 3 Aug (Economy) | +10h10 | $300 compensation |
| 10 | Grace Liu (R6107) | None | AA206 09:05–15:15, 4 Aug (Economy) | +25h35, next day | $240 compensation (the $300 rate, capped at her $240 fare) + $180 hotel |
| 11 | Ana Ruiz (R6101) | None | AA206 09:05–15:15, 4 Aug (Economy) | +25h35, next day | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 12 | Elena Fox (R6105) | None | AA204 09:05–15:15, 3 Aug (Basic Economy) | +1h35 | None |

How the harder cases were decided:
- **Iris upgrade:** UA88 was the earliest flight but its Economy was full. As a platinum member travelling alone on a single flight, she was moved up one cabin on it.
- **Lea upgrade:** Premium Economy was full on both UA88 and AA204, and the next Premium Economy seat (DL512) would only reach Chicago at 18:40. As a gold member travelling alone, she was moved up one cabin to AA204 Business.
- **Ben, no upgrade:** Iris and Chloe had already taken the cabin above Economy on UA88, and AA204 had no Premium Economy seats. That left DL512 Economy.
- **Dev and Mo:** The new first flight broke their 15:30 connection to Boston, so I rebooked that flight too. Every Economy seat to Chicago before AA210 had gone to higher-priority passengers. AA210 lands at 23:50 and the next-morning flight to Boston counts as a valid connection.
- **Jun and Kofi:** They are booked to travel together, so they were kept together in their own cabin, ranked at Kofi's gold priority, with no upgrade.

The task didn't involve any customer requests in the queue, so I didn't change or resolve any.
